description: The questions Laya answers about a caller's turn. Single source of truth for the seed/test labels, the benchmark (#6), data generation (#7, #12) and the backend decision layer (#15). Changing it is a shared-contract change: both owners review.

department.instructions: Which municipal department should handle this complaint?

criteria.water: drinking water supply: no water, low pressure, burst or leaking pipes, dirty or contaminated tap water, water tankers
criteria.sewage-drainage: sewage, underground drainage, blocked or overflowing drains, open or broken manholes, broken drain slabs, rainwater flooding of streets
criteria.solid-waste: garbage collection, garbage heaps, overflowing bins, dumped debris, burning garbage, dead animals on the road
criteria.roads: potholes, damaged or dug-up roads, footpath encroachment, speed breakers, roads blocked by fallen trees
criteria.streetlights: street lights not working or on during the day, fallen or sparking wires from light poles, bent or falling poles
criteria.stray-animals: stray dogs, dog bites, cattle on roads, monkeys, snakes
criteria.other: any other civic matter (parks, mosquito fogging, building permissions) or a request that is not a civic complaint

ward.instructions: Which ward of Hosapura is the complaint about?
ward.note: Options are the ward ids in wards.json plus 'unknown'. A ward counts only if the caller names it or a landmark unique to that ward.

safety_hazard.instructions: Is there an immediate risk to someone's life or health, such as a live wire, an open manhole, flooding into a house, contaminated drinking water or an animal attack?

has_location.instructions: Did the caller give a usable location: a ward, a street, or a landmark?

repeat_complaint.instructions: Does the caller say this problem was already reported or has been pending for a long time despite complaints?

wants_human.instructions: Does the caller ask to speak to a human officer instead of the automated system?

criteria.frustrated: annoyed or impatient, complaining about delays, but not insulting
criteria.distressed: scared, panicking or pleading because someone may be hurt

out_of_scope.instructions: Is this not a municipal civic complaint at all, for example police, medical emergency, electricity bills, ration cards or a private dispute with neighbours?

contains_personal_id.instructions: Does the caller say a phone number, Aadhaar number, account number or other personal ID number?
